description: This file defines a class 'CodeIndexStateManager' that manages and reports the state of code indexing, including progress updates, system status, and related metadata, using VSCode's event emitter.

classes.name: CodeIndexStateManager
classes.description: A class that manages the state and progress of code indexing, providing methods to update status, report progress, and emit events for status changes.

methods.name: getCurrentStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status object containing system state, message, progress, and metadata.

methods.name: setSystemState
methods.description: Sets the system's indexing state, updates related metadata, and emits a status update if changed.

methods.name: reportBlockIndexingProgress
methods.description: Reports progress of block indexing, updating counters and emitting progress events.

methods.name: reportFileQueueProgress
methods.description: Reports progress of file queue processing, updating counters and emitting progress events.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the event emitter to clean up resources.
